method.scope: Every measured variant has only performance changes relative to UI3, without UI4 title or combat motion changes.
method.limits: Unpaced host CPU intervals and requested file ranges, not Firebird or physical-calculator time. Split physical reads may differ at a segment boundary. CPU ranges overlap and vary substantially; these samples do not establish a stable CPU speedup.

change.details: Separate the existing page metadata from its contiguous byte storage. A sub-page request straddling two absent pages fills both with one source call only when the original replacement sequence selects adjacent slots. Wrapped or nonadjacent victims retain the old two-read path.

verification.first_sanitizer_attempt: Failed at LeakSanitizer process inspection under the sandbox ptrace monitor; unchanged binaries passed outside that monitor. No sanitizer was disabled and no stack limit changed.
